counterhypothesis: The smallest conventional independent semantic parser/validator, composed with typed Clay validation and explicit ambiguity handling, matches SPL hard-field safety while using less complexity/resources; any failure-diversity advantage from SPL can be reproduced with ordinary redundant validators.

tests.name: five independent replications
tests.result: 0 false allow / 0 false deny for both strong mechanisms in all replications; full validator lower p50 in each run

remaining_uncertainty: A real German validator may require a second neural/model semantic parser, while narrow hard-field oracles may be materially cheaper. This resource/coverage hypothesis remains unmeasured and is the only current reopen path for an SPL-like decomposition.
durable_action: Target issue #162 records a conventional-first implementation and test obligation for independent hard-field translation validation.
